enchantments.tooltip: Seeker +14: Provides a +14 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +14 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Physical Sheltering +18: +18 Insight bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Armor-Piercing 23%: Passive: +23% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
